## See it on a real project [...] Coming next: hosted Cube, hosted SLayer, hosted & queryable Snowflake Semantic View, hosted and & queryable Databricks Metric Views and Looker / LookML.

## Dex Semantics

Let your agent build analytics with 25% fewer errors, thanks to data that explains itself to your coding agent.

A join can keep running after the source changes underneath it, and quietly count every row twice. Dex Semantics keeps each model's meaning with the model, as code, so that kind of error is caught instead of shipped: [...] More in the package README.

We run Dex on two public analytics-engineering benchmarks and commit every run's raw per-task results, including the ones that flatter us least.

| Benchmark | Setup | Result | Details |
 ---  --- |
| data-eng-bench (Snowflake, 103 tasks) | Dex + Claude Sonnet 5 | 57.3% resolved, 89.7% of assertions pass | README |
| ADE-bench (dbt Labs, 75 tasks) | Dex 1.17.4 + Claude Sonnet 5.5 | 80% resolved vs 73.3% without Dex; 25% fewer failures | README |

On ADE-bench, the same Claude Sonnet 5.5 model solves 60 of 75 tasks with Dex, compared with 55 without it: +6.7 percentage points, with net gains across six of seven projects. Both configurations make one scored attempt per task. Compare the runs and raw results.
